note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: 5 dated customs shipping-bill records (BOL 9835274, 9727744, 9650237, 9502485, 9333716) between 2026-02-03 and 2026-02-19, all frozen shrimp (HS 03061720 / 03061740) shipped from Nhava Sheva Sea to UAE, Germany, Japan and the Dominican Republic. Declared HS 030617 matches the observed 8-digit codes 03061720/03061740 — no HS correction needed. Role: exporter of frozen shrimp (Litopenaeus vannamei / sea tiger), consistent with manufacturer-exporter or manufacturer_trader; the free customs view does not distinguish own processing from traded goods, so role is not asserted. Registered address on record: Office No 2, Fortune Plaza, Plot No 29/30, Sector-19A, Vashi (Maharashtra) — matches state_claimed. PAN AAOCS3053J was not independently verified (registry pages blocked, HTTP 403) and is carried as claimed only. Domestic supply evidence: not found in accessible public sources — this is a data-access gap, not evidence of absence, so domestic_status is unknown rather than none_found.
